sections.text_helper: Section 24.4.7 "OPAMP enable" in chapter 24 (Operational amplifier (OPAMP)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 730.
sections.section_content:
When disabled (default upon reset), the OPAMP control and calibration registers can still be
modified. The operational amplifier output OUT is in high-Z state.
It is recommended to update the OPAMP registers while the OPAMP peripheral is disabled,
to avoid spurious effects on the output.
OPAMP is enabled by setting the OPAEN bit of the OPAMP_CSR register. The INP and INM
inputs and the OUT output are connected through the embedded multiplexers according to
the control register settings and the timer control signals.
